Container.Name: Lansweeper-Network-Discovery

Branch.TagDescription: Latest Hub and IT Sensor release from Lansweeper

Container.Overview:
Unofficial container for Lansweeper Network Discovery. It runs the Hub and the IT Sensor together: the sensor scans your network, and the Hub sends what it finds to your Lansweeper Site. Not affiliated with or supported by Lansweeper.
The image installs the official Linux packages from Lansweeper's apt repository when it is built, and is rebuilt when Lansweeper releases a new version.
To link it to your Site, paste the linking code from your Site (Discovery > Discovery systems > Link discovery system) into Linking Code, or link it from the web UI after the first start. The web UI uses a self-signed certificate.
First start: open https://your-server:59526/ (the Setup Port) and set the admin password. The Hub only allows this from the server itself, so the container relays that port locally until the password is set, then closes it. After that, use the WebUI link.
Host networking is required for discovery to see your LAN. Keep appdata on cache or an SSD: the Hub uses a SQLite database, and SQLite over a network share is unreliable.

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Hub database, certificate, settings and logs, and the sensor's settings. Put this on cache or an SSD.

Config.Name: Linking Code
Config.Description: Optional. Linking code from your Lansweeper Site. Applied once; changing it applies the new code. Leave empty to link from the web UI instead.

Config.Name: Hub HTTPS Port
Config.Description: Port for the Hub web UI and the sensor connection. With host networking this is the port on the server.

Config.Name: Setup Port
Config.Description: Open https://your-server:59526/ once to set the admin password. The port is only open until the password is set. Set to 0 to disable it.

Config.Name: Passive Only
Config.Description: Leave empty to use active scanning on first start and keep whatever you set in the Hub UI after that. true = listen passively only, false = active scanning.

Config.Name: Enable IT Sensor
Config.Description: Run the IT Sensor alongside the Hub. Set to false for a Hub only.

Config.Name: Hub Code
Config.Description: Optional. Hub code for pairing the sensor, if the Hub UI asks for one.

Config.Name: Hub Hostname
Config.Description: Optional. Hostname the Hub listens on and advertises. Defaults to the server's hostname.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: Verbose, Debug, Information, Warning or Error.
